notes.title: Get in quick if you want to test our newest features first!
notes.content:
We've been relatively quiet on the updates front and that's for a good reason.

Our stellar (heh) dev has been hard at work rebuilding our game on Quantum to maximise performance without turning your game machine of choice in to a jet-engine-taking-off-sounding-brick!

While also adding in the next slew of features for our final (end?) game!

Including:
- New ship bodies
- A ship sandbox for you to personalise boosters, weapons and components
- Customisable ship parts
- A new game mode
- Levelled up bots (if there aren't enough people online to match you with)

But before it makes it all the way to our current and available build (i.e. you), we need a select few who [url=https://discord.gg/yMzZ3t9ta3]we'll be selecting from our Discord[/url] to test it and make sure everything's working at a very base level. Testing will begin within a week, so time is also of the essence!

So join the Discord now if early game development and feedback is your thing!

If it's not, don't worry it'll make it to the main branch of our Steam in the few weeks after and you can play the more polished and refined version instead.

notes.title: Craft mode under development!
notes.content:
We're in the process of wrapping up our Combat Beta (although to those who already have access, we'll be keeping it live).

So we've been busy:
- Rebuilding on Quantum
- Planning out the gameplay loop for salvaging parts and gathering components to upgrade your ships
- Working on the customisation mechanics

In the preview you can see the very start of our UI to do so, what do you think?

What's your favourite ship and how excited are you to arm it with a different gun?[previewyoutube=fBKprlTMnmc;full][/previewyoutube]
